sn39.1-15:1.1: Ekaṃ samayam āyasmā Sāriputto Vajjīsu viharati Ukkavelāyaṃ Gaṅgāya nadiyā tīre || 2
sn39.1-15:1.2: Atha kho Sāmaṇḍako paribbājako yenāyasmā Sāriputto tenupasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā āyasmatā Sāriputtena saddhiṃ sammodi ||
sn39.1-15:1.3: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekam antam nisīdi || || 3 Ekam antaṃ nisinno kho Sāmaṇḍako paribbājako āyasmantaṃ Sāriputtam etad avoca || ||
sn39.1-15:2.3: Yo kho āvuso rāgakkhayo dosakkhayo mohakkhayo
sn39.1-15:2.5: Atthi panāvuso maggo atthi paṭipadā etassa nibbānassa sacchikiriyāyāti || ||
sn39.1-15:2.6: Atthi kho āvuso maggo atthi paṭipadā etassa nibbanassa sacchikiriyāyāti || || 5
sn39.1-15:3.1: Katamo panāvuso maggo katamā paṭipadā etassa nibbānassa sacchikiriyāyāti || ||
sn39.1-15:3.2: Ayam eva kho āvuso ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo etassa nibbānassa sacchikiriyāya seyyathīdaṃ ||
sn39.1-15:3.4: ayaṃ kho āvuso maggo ayam paṭipadā etassa nibbānassa sacchikiriyāyāti || || 6
sn39.1-15:3.5: Bhaddako āvuso maggo bhaddikā paṭipadā etassa nibbānassa sacchikiriyāya ||
